name: Website Forensics
purpose: Inspect public websites to extract layout, typography, interaction, and styling patterns.
inputs: At most five public-site forensic questions
Target product screens and design-token scale
Viewport ladder, capture date, and conduct constraints
outputs: Measured teardown for each scoped public-site question
Token mapping and accessibility caution scorecard
stop_conditions: All scoped public-site questions have measurements, token mappings, cautions, and a recommendation
